title: How to Report a Fraud Transaction at ZX Bank

nodes.title: Step 1: Contact ZX Bank Immediately
nodes.summary: Contact the 24x7 fraud hotline (different numbers for India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal), email fraudreport@zxbank.asia, or use the app's Support > Report Fraud.

nodes.title: Step 2: Block Your Card or Account (If Applicable)
nodes.summary: Block the card or freeze the account through Card Management or Account Services in the mobile app or NetBanking.

nodes.title: Step 3: Gather Key Information
nodes.summary: Before reporting, collect your account number/User ID, date and time of the transaction, amount details, any SMS/email alerts, and screenshots or documentation.

nodes.title: Step 4: File a Written Complaint
nodes.summary: Submit a written complaint at any branch, or online via NetBanking > Service Requests > Dispute Transaction or an email to fraudreport@zxbank.asia.

nodes.title: Step 5: Follow Up & Track Resolution
nodes.summary: ZX Bank issues a reference number; track progress in the app (Support > Track Requests) or by hotline, with resolution targeted within 10 working days.

nodes.title: Extra Tips
nodes.summary: Never share PIN, OTP or passwords, activate SMS/email transaction alerts, regularly review statements, and use 'Block Instantly' in the app for urgent blocking.
